# CANDIDATE: TIME_OF_DAY_FILTER_LATER_START

**Filed:** 2026-07-23  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup currently requires entries at 09:35 ET or later. Early entries (09:35-09:50 ET) may suffer from incomplete market structure formation and higher false trigger rates due to overnight gap resolution and initial volatility spikes. Delaying entry to 09:50 ET or later allows for clearer intraday trend confirmation while preserving the core anchor day entries (all occur after 09:50 ET).

## Mechanism

Modify the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON time-of-day context filter from "09:35 ET or later" to "09:50 ET or later". All other trigger conditions (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence, volume divergence check, VIX confirmation) remain unchanged. Exit logic (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop catastrophe cap, TP1/runner management) is unaltered. This is a pure filter change affecting only entry eligibility.
